public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_NO_DATA = -11; // No Data Available public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_DUPREQ = -12; // Request already in progress public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_UNKNOWN = -13; // other error public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_INVALID_SYMBOL = -14; // Invalid Symbol public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_NOT_ENT = -15; // Not Entitleted public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_NOT_ENT_ENDTIME = -19; public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_NOT_ENT_STARTTIME = -20; public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_NOT_ENT_REQTIME = -21; public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_HEADER_ERROR = -25; // Parameters wrong in request header public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_REQINCORRECT = -26; // The request provided to the server is incorrect and cannot be satisfied public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE = -27; // Server temporarily unavailable public static final int HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR_SERVERBUSY = -28; // Not returning queried data as server is busy...

Status.STATUS_BYTE_FIVE - Enum in com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote
This enum is used with the index 4 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[4] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
Status.STATUS_BYTE_FOUR - Enum in com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote
This enum is used with the index 3 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[3] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
Status.STATUS_BYTE_ONE - Enum in com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote
This enum is used with the index 0 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[0] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
Status.STATUS_BYTE_SIX - Enum in com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote
This enum is used with the index 5 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[5] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
Status.STATUS_BYTE_THREE - Enum in com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote
This enum is used with the index 2 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[2] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
Status.STATUS_BYTE_TWO - Enum in com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote
This enum is used with the index 1 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[1] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
